parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the stretching of a spring. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 1.1. Fig. 1.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • Record the scale reading S 0 on the metre rule at the level of the bottom of the spring, as shown in Fig. 1.1. S 0 = ........................................................ mm • Hang a load L of 1.0 N on the spring. Record, in Table 1.1, the scale reading S on the metre rule at the level of the bottom of the spring. • Calculate the extension e of the spring using the equation e = ( S – S 0 ). Record the value of e in the table. • Repeat the procedure using loads L of 2.0 N, 3.0 N, 4.0 N and 5.0 N. Record all the readings and results in the table.
